title: Pie Reveal:
headline: The payoff: the pie hits Rod. It is already filmed, so this cuts now; only the result line waits for the final numbers.
story: We open on the pie inches from Rod's face with “Giving ShoesDay results are in...”. A quick flash of the goal cards from the Announcement and the Pie Tease, then the hit from every angle, slow motion if there is.

Rod laughs and wipes his face under the result line. Then the thank-you over the kids, and Sydney's end slide with the next goal: 5,000 kids this holiday season. Playful first, sincere at the thank-you. Do not end on the joke.

One pass, now. The hit is already on tape from the staff retreat: full pie video.MOV, IMG_2700, IMG_2708 and IMG_2711. Cut the whole video now; only the result line can still change after the Giving ShoesDay totals.
do: Open on the pie coming in at 25% slow motion, card on screen from frame 1.
Show the hit from two angles; slow the first contact to 50% (60 fps source).
Use the goal-hit result line for now (Sydney confirms after Giving ShoesDay).
Close on Rod's real “Thank you for your support.”
Keep it 30 to 40 s; hold cards longer if you need the time.
dont: No Christmas imagery. Holiday vibes only.
No logo at 0:00. The S4S logo is already on the end slide.
Don't lock the result line. Build it as text you can swap.
Don't use the voices of the people throwing the pies.

files: Nick's editor brief on this Monday item (29 Oct). This page is that plan.
S4S - Giving ShoesDay + End of Year 2026 - client editing doc (Sydney, 19 Oct). On-screen words are Sydney's.
Pie videos - Rod (Drive): full pie video.MOV, IMG_2700.MOV, IMG_2708.MOV, IMG_2711.MOV, thank you for the support .MOV, IMG_2678.MOV
1 second each of the goal cards from your own Announcement (13330680112) and Pie Tease (13330679608) cuts.
Warm licensed instrumental, playful at the start, sincere at the thank-you. Same family as the other pie videos.

Sydney's holiday end slide: Holiday_bkg_social_V1_2.jpg (light blue) or Holiday_bkg_social_V2_2.jpg (dark blue). 9:16, the Soles4Souls wordmark is already in the top of the slide. CTA text in the open middle; no extra logo.

S4S graphics package (Drive): lower third bar, title plate, underline, circle burst, focus brackets, color wipe, shape swipe, topic tag, texture and gradient loops, 1080×1920, 30 fps, ProRes 4444. The plates are empty: type the words on them. The Motion graphics tab on this page has the graphics this script asks for as transparent .mov files.

Giving ShoesDay is Tuesday, December 1st. Goal: 2,500 kids with new shoes. End of Year runs December 2 to 31; goal 5,000 kids. Spelling: Soles4Souls, Giving ShoesDay (capital S and D), 4EveryKid, s4s.org/gsd.

Ready-made in the Motion graphics tab: Sydney's holiday slide with this video's call to action already on it. Plain slides: V1 light blue · V2 dark blue. The S4S logo is already on the slide; no extra logo.
tech: iPhone HEVC. full pie video.MOV is 2160×3840, 60 fps; the IMG_ clips are 1080×1920, 29.97 fps.
1080×1920, 30 fps. Use the 60 fps take for the 50% slow motion on the first hit.
Horizontal clips: crop to 9:16 with faces inside the frame. Never stretch.

Cards big and centered, out of the bottom 20% and away from the right edge (Instagram buttons sit there). Hold each card long enough to read twice: text size is Soles4Souls' most common note. Titles in Buenos Aires (Roboto Black if you don't have it), body Roboto. Black text on teal, never white on teal. The first card is on screen at 0:00 and does not animate on; later cards can.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, 9:16 only. Upload to Frame.io with the Edit Key in the file name.
None: there are no spoken lines. The cards are the text.
checklist: Result line on its own text layer, ready to swap.
First card on screen at frame 1. No logo at 0:00.
Every card matches Sydney's words exactly. The result line is on its own layer.
No held still frame: slow motion only.
The video ends on the kids and the next goal, not on the joke.
Text readable on a phone. Nothing in the bottom 20% or under the right-side buttons.
End = Sydney's holiday slide + the exact CTA from this plan. No extra logo: the wordmark is already on the slide.
1080×1920, 24 fps timeline, Edit Key in the file name.

decisions.b: Use Sydney's goal-hit line for now. If the goal is missed, her other result line (in her doc and in Nick's brief) replaces it. Sydney confirms after the Giving ShoesDay totals; Nick passes it on.

client_note: Why this matters: Giving ShoesDay (1 Dec) is Soles4Souls' biggest day of the year. Sydney wrote every line herself: keep it joy themed and positive.
